page.layout: One printed page: an engraved title cartouche with an oval title panel, centre-left. At the right edge, the cut-off edge of the neighbouring page's text (not transcribed). Below the cartouche, a library stamp and show-through of mirrored text (not transcribed).
page.notes: The oval title panel is set in roman capitals, with a smaller italic line below. The first line reads GRÆCORVM, with a possible reading "GRÆCORVM" above "RESPVBLICÆ" [?]. The third and fourth lines ("de" / "VERONÆ ENNIO") are uncertain: the letters are worn and partly obscured by the engraving's shading, so they are marked as doubtful. The fifth line ("Dedicatum") is a guess and is not confirmed. The last line is illegible. The lower part of the panel shows mirrored (upside-down) show-through from the reverse, which is not transcribed. The right edge carries cut-off fragments of the neighbouring page (ONT, Vu, tanus Re, vitarum, Lucian, de Repub, publica, De Rep, Apparet, Dicar, Comple, Gam, &, da), which belong to another page and are left out. Library stamp (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München) and the scan's ink marks are omitted. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
